answer: Timber-float slots on the Amber Gorge used to be booked by replaying a taped ping from a hut speaker, so one dispatcher collected six tow bonuses without leaving the stove. A claimant now has to stand under the hillside echo wall, seat a 38 mm numbered marble cube in a 200 °C ember cup until a hairline opens across the serial, photograph that crack beside the 14.6 g bond ticket, and wait until opposite-bank recorders both print an 18 ms delay. A loudspeaker playback cannot heat-crack a fresh cube or agree with both banks, so the slot stays closed.
